about: R7 requirements (docs/mandate/20261120-R7-consolidated-acceptance-mandate.md), requirements discovered while building, and external dependencies. Rendered with the inherited rows of CAPABILITIES.md into REGISTER.md by scripts/register.ts, which also checks every reference. Levels: P = product journey through the integrated application in a browser; I = integration through the API on an isolated stack; C = component or unit test; E = experiment or research artefact; D = document or analysis only; U = claimed, not verified; '-' = nothing yet. 'needs' is the lowest level at which the entry may be called Met.

dependencies.what: Authorisation to run the model-path adversarial corpus against an actual model (each run is a metered call)
Participants for human evaluation (comprehension, completion, errors, screen-reader users) under ISO 9241-210
Independent professional application, contract and penetration assessment
Authorised provider sandbox accounts (for example an exchange testnet or a broker paper account) if any journey is to run against a provider instead of the local chain
Market-data licences or written permission for any display beyond the owner's own review
Qualified legal and regulatory opinion, and the registrations or licences it identifies, before real money (custody, KYC/AML, investment execution, VDA, payments)
An identity-verification provider's sandbox and agreement
Separate approval for the release phase: GitHub push, Railway services, secrets, key rotation of the published testnet keys
Field (real-user) performance data, which needs a hosted deployment with consented telemetry

For any real-money phase in India: an Indian company (PAN, TAN, GSTIN, bank account), a regulated payment partner for escrow, e-mandates and payouts (QED may not run marketplace escrow itself), a route for mutual-fund orders (registered platform or distributor; personalised proposals only through a registered adviser), and FIU-IND registration or counsel's confirmation for digital assets

Organiser answers on the final: the on-site hackathon task and how the final is judged, whether work after 20 Oct may be shown, which network's transaction hashes count, and how the 0-5 bonus is awarded (draft questions: docs/research/qed-research-intel/20261122-topic-f-compliance.md, section 6). Contacting the organisers is the owner's to do

Approval for a public test network (Sepolia) run: deploying the passkey-owned wallet contracts and sending a small number of transactions with faucet test ether. Outward-facing and permanent on a public chain; prepared locally first
An India-region cloud account (Mumbai, with Hyderabad for recovery) and the owner's approval to spend on a pilot stack (D-070); priced in the cost/quality table
Per-institution data-access and payment-channel agreements, and agent registration where an institution offers it
The owner's own devices (a phone and a computer with platform passkeys) for a recorded real-device passkey test
A reviewer of a model family other than Claude for the R8 proofs (D-096 item 7)

Real email and text-message delivery: a provider account (email, e.g. Postmark or Amazon SES, with a verified sending domain and SPF/DKIM/DMARC; SMS, e.g. Twilio or MSG91, with sender ID and templates registered on TRAI's DLT platform for Indian numbers), its credential kept out of source control, and the owner's approval for cost and data sharing
Assistive-technology testing with people who use screen readers and other assistive technology, on real devices

entries.note: 22 Nov 2026: the original 30-case corpus (recovered verbatim from docs/standards/LLM-AGENTIC.md) plus 20 added cases (8 of them on the on-chain wallet, run on the stack's own vault service), through the real Ask pipeline on an isolated stack against a scripted model emitting exactly what an attacker wants. In every case and both runs no money moved and nothing became authority without the owner's passkey over the exact terms (on the wallet, over every digest the chain checks), and every planted fault was caught by its checker. The eleven pre-signing defects of the first run are fixed, each turned from an expected failure into a passing test, and a twelfth found while fixing them (a withdrawn proposal reopened through the editor) is fixed too; the second run's one failure (W05, a reserve target outside 2 to 80 shown as valid) is fixed in QED's own check after it. Since then (22 Nov, evening and night): X01 is two passing cases, not an observation (a look-alike payee needs the owner's confirmation to be added, and every payment or bills instruction to it says what it imitates in the signed document; RISK-073); the tamper cases rewrite the recorded call that history is now replayed from (D-087); a question to Ask, its earlier turns and the model's reply are shown in evidence only to the asker and admins (RISK-070). The corpus ran 49/50 on 08cd378 (v3: W07 failed only because the forged turn no longer reached the model at all), then 50/50 and stable across two runs on ccecf7b (v4), ff3b247 (v5) and 97eae28 (v6), every seeded fault caught. Open observations: grounding matched by value (X07), a confusable "cancel" (X09), stored turns and recorded calls without integrity (I3). Nothing here tests a real model (R7-081, EXT-01).

views.title: Complete product
views.rule: Every entry and every inherited capability Met at the level it needs, with external dependencies resolved, not waived. Passing the competition or the production view does not pass this one.

views.title: Competition readiness: FinTechathon Topic F final, 28-29 Nov 2026
views.rule: What the final can be judged on: task completion (40%) on on-chain transaction hashes; security and compliance (30%: induced transfers, data extraction, privilege escalation, prompt injection, with heavy deductions); innovation and interaction (30%: novelty, real-world value, dialogue efficiency, clarification, correction, fallback); a 0-5 bonus for on-chain exploration whose criteria are not published. Sources: docs/competition/ and docs/research/qed-research-intel/20261122-topic-f-compliance.md. Passing this view does not pass the product view.

views.title: Production readiness: real money
views.rule: What real money would need besides the legal structure (N-008). Deployment stays prohibited until the owner approves it (D-070), so the host-dependent checks stay open until then. Passing this view does not pass the product view.
